items.jp: 電話したらすぐに来てくれた

translation.pt-BR: Quando liguei, ele veio na hora.
translation.en: When I called, he came right over.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 来る to the auxiliary くれる, forming 来てくれた ('came to do me the favor'); this is the typical connection for verbs of giving/receiving favors.
tokens: object (part of the compound verb 電話する)
main verb of the conditional clause

items.jp: この歌はみんなに歌われている

translation.pt-BR: Essa música é cantada por todo mundo.
translation.en: This song is sung by everyone.

items.label: links the verb to the auxiliary いる
items.explanation: て connects 歌われ to いる forming 〜ている, which expresses the ongoing or habitual action.

items.jp: 音を小さくしてください

translation.pt-BR: Abaixa o volume, por favor.
translation.en: Please turn the volume down.

items.label: connector て
items.explanation: て links the verb し (of する) to the auxiliary ください, forming the request 〜てください (please do).

items.jp: 新聞社の前で待っている

translation.pt-BR: Estou esperando na frente da empresa de jornal.
translation.en: I'm waiting in front of the newspaper company.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links the verb 待つ to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている, which expresses that the waiting is in progress.

items.jp: その映画はまだ見ていません

translation.pt-BR: Ainda não vi aquele filme.
translation.en: I haven't seen that movie yet.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb to the following element (another verb or auxiliary) in the て-form.

items.jp: 電気を明るくしてください

translation.pt-BR: Deixa a luz mais clara, por favor.
translation.en: Please make the light brighter.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links して to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください ('please do...').

items.jp: コップを洗ってください

translation.pt-BR: Lave o copo, por favor.
translation.en: Wash the glass, please.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links the verb 洗う to ください, forming the request 洗ってください (please wash).

items.jp: 音楽を小さくしてください

translation.pt-BR: Abaixe o volume da música, por favor.
translation.en: Please turn down the volume of the music.

items.label: conjunctive (て-form)
items.explanation: て links 小さくし to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください ('please make...').

items.jp: そのおもちゃはプラスチックでできている

translation.pt-BR: Aquele brinquedo é feito de plástico.
translation.en: That toy is made of plastic.

items.label: conjunctive particle of the て form
items.explanation: て links でき to いる forming ている, the resulting state 'is made of'.

items.jp: 先生が教室に入ってきた

translation.pt-BR: O professor entrou na sala de aula.
translation.en: The teacher came into the classroom.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 入る to the auxiliary verb くる, forming 〜てくる ('to come in toward here').

items.jp: 弟にもっと勉強してほしい

translation.pt-BR: Eu queria que meu irmão mais novo estudasse mais.
translation.en: I wish my younger brother would study more.

items.label: conjunctive particle of the て-form
items.explanation: Links the verb (して) to the auxiliary ほしい, forming the pattern 〜てほしい which indicates the wish for someone else to perform the action.
tokens: target of the wish (who should perform the action)
verbal object (nominal part of 勉強する)
main verb (light auxiliary する of 勉強する)

items.jp: 野菜を食べるようにしてほしい

translation.pt-BR: Quero que você passe a comer verduras.
translation.en: I want you to start eating vegetables.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links する (して) to the adjective ほしい, forming the pattern 〜てほしい ('I want (someone) to do').
tokens: verb of the よう clause

items.jp: なるべく早く来てください

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, venha o mais cedo possível.
translation.en: Please come as early as possible.

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links the verb 来る to ください to form the request 'please come' (て-form + ください).

items.jp: この花は薬になると考えられている

translation.pt-BR: Acredita-se que esta flor vira remédio.
translation.en: This flower is believed to turn into medicine.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Links 考えられ to the auxiliary いる, forming the continuous/stative aspect 考えられている ('it is thought / it is believed').
tokens: complement of なる (what it turns into)

items.jp: ボールペンを貸してください

translation.pt-BR: Me empresta uma caneta, por favor.
translation.en: Please lend me a pen.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て puts 貸す in the て-form and links it to ください, forming the request 'lend it to me, please'.

items.jp: 電車が止まっているんです

translation.pt-BR: É que o trem está parado.
translation.en: It's because the train is stopped.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 止まる to the auxiliary いる, creating the form 〜ている of continuous state.

items.jp: この犬は茶色くてかわいい

translation.pt-BR: Este cachorro é marrom e fofinho.
translation.en: This dog is brown and cute.

items.label: connective particle (links adjectives)
items.explanation: This て is part of the form 茶色くて and serves to chain the adjective 茶色い to the following adjective, like the 'and' in English.

items.jp: もし時間があったら電話してください

translation.pt-BR: Se você tiver tempo, me liga, por favor.
translation.en: If you have time, please give me a call.

items.label: linking particle 〜て
items.explanation: て connects する to ください, forming the request 'please do' (してください).
tokens: object / base of the compound verb

items.jp: 引き出しを開けてください

translation.pt-BR: Abra a gaveta, por favor.
translation.en: Please open the drawer.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て connects the verb 開ける to ください, forming the polite request 〜てください ('please do').

items.jp: その人を知っている

translation.pt-BR: Eu conheço essa pessoa.
translation.en: I know that person.

items.label: conjunctive particle (て-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 知っ to the auxiliary いる, creating the construction 〜ている which expresses a continuous state ("to know" as the state of one who already knows).

items.jp: この道をまっすぐ行ってください

translation.pt-BR: Siga reto por essa rua, por favor.
translation.en: Please go straight down this street.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て is the て-form of 行く (行って); it joins the verb to ください to form the request 〜てください.

items.jp: パーティーに飲み物を持って行く

translation.pt-BR: Vou levar bebida para a festa.
translation.en: I'll bring drinks to the party.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 持つ to 行く, forming 持って行く ('to take/bring along'). It is the conjunction that chains the first verb to the second.

items.jp: 父は長い間その産業で働いています

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai trabalha nessa indústria há muito tempo.
translation.en: My father has worked in this industry for a long time.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 働く to the auxiliary いる, forming 〜ている, the construction that expresses continuous/habitual action.
tokens: adverb of duration (head of 長い間)

items.jp: 父は古いレコードをたくさん持っている

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai tem muitos discos de vinil antigos.
translation.en: My dad has a lot of old vinyl records.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 持つ to the auxiliary いる to form 持っている, expressing the continuous state of possessing.

items.jp: わたしは日本語を習っています

translation.pt-BR: Eu estou aprendendo japonês.
translation.en: I'm learning Japanese.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て is the conjunctive ending that turns 習う into 習って, allowing the verb to be linked to the auxiliary いる to form the continuous aspect 〜ている.

items.jp: かんじの 書き方を おしえてください

translation.pt-BR: Me ensina como escrever kanji, por favor.
translation.en: Please teach me how to write kanji.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb おしえる to ください, creating the polite request structure 〜てください ("please do...").

items.jp: 高くてもこの服を買います

translation.pt-BR: Mesmo que seja caro, vou comprar esta roupa.
translation.en: Even if it's expensive, I'm going to buy these clothes.

items.label: connector of the 〜て form (of an adjective)
items.explanation: て closes the form 高くて of the adjective 高い and prepares the link with も to form 〜ても.
tokens: adjective of the concessive clause (〜ても)

items.jp: 日本語とか英語とかを勉強している

translation.pt-BR: Estou estudando coisas como japonês e inglês.
translation.en: I'm studying things like Japanese and English.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links し (from する) to the auxiliary いる, forming the continuous structure 〜ている.
tokens: verbal noun (head of 勉強する)

items.jp: 色々な人がこのブログを見ているようです

translation.pt-BR: Parece que vários tipos de pessoas estão lendo este blog.
translation.en: It seems that various kinds of people are reading this blog.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 見 to いる to form the progressive construction 見ている (to be doing).

items.jp: かならず近所の人が出てくる

translation.pt-BR: Os vizinhos sempre aparecem.
translation.en: The neighbors always come out.

items.label: links the verb to the auxiliary くる
items.explanation: て connects 出る to the auxiliary くる, forming ~てくる (movement approaching the speaker / something that emerges).

items.jp: 考えてみるよ。

translation.pt-BR: Vou pensar nisso.
translation.en: I'll think about it.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: Joins 考える to the auxiliary みる to form the construction 〜てみる ('to try/give it a go').

items.jp: その本には何が書いてあるの？

translation.pt-BR: O que está escrito nesse livro?
translation.en: What's written in the book?

items.label: connective particle of the te-form
items.explanation: て links the verb 書く to ある, forming the 〜てある construction of resultant state.

items.jp: はっきり言ってよ。

translation.pt-BR: Fala sem rodeios, vai.
translation.en: Tell me what you mean.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て forms 言って, which alone at the end functions as an informal request ('do it').

items.jp: 買い物に行っているところです。

translation.pt-BR: Estou indo fazer compras agora mesmo.
translation.en: I am going for shopping now.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: This て is the connector that links 行く to いる to form 〜ている. It has no translation of its own; it merely allows the main verb to be chained with the aspectual auxiliary.
tokens: formal noun marking the point of the action (part of the target 〜ているところ)

items.jp: それ、やってあげるよ。

translation.pt-BR: Isso aí eu faço pra você.
translation.en: I'll do that for you.

items.label: connective particle て (links the verb to the auxiliary)
items.explanation: The て turns やる into やって to link to あげる, forming 〜てあげる (an action done in favor of the listener).

items.jp: タダでやってあげるよ。

translation.pt-BR: Eu faço isso de graça pra você.
translation.en: I'll do that for you for free.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb やる to the auxiliary あげる, forming the benefactive construction 〜てあげる ('to do for someone').

items.jp: 明後日、転校生が来ることになっている。

translation.pt-BR: Depois de amanhã, está combinado que um aluno transferido vai chegar.
translation.en: It's been arranged that a transfer student will arrive the day after tomorrow.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links なっ (なる) to いる to form なっている (already established arrangement).
tokens: formal noun that nominalizes the preceding clause
verb of the ことになっている pattern

items.jp: 生まれてきてよかった。

translation.pt-BR: Que bom ter nascido.
translation.en: I'm happy that I was born.

items.label: 〜て connector linking 生まれる to the auxiliary くる
items.explanation: This て turns 生まれる into 生まれて to attach the auxiliary くる, forming the compound 生まれてくる ('to come into life').

items.jp: だんだん分かってきたよ。

translation.pt-BR: Aos poucos estou começando a entender.
translation.en: I'm beginning to understand.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Links the verb 分かる to the auxiliary くる, forming the construction 〜てくる, which expresses a gradual change that advances up to the present.

items.jp: 聞かせてください。

translation.pt-BR: Deixe-me ouvir.
translation.en: Let me hear it.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the causative verb to ください, forming the request 'please do'.

items.jp: 魚は生かしておくよ。

translation.pt-BR: Vou manter o peixe vivo, viu.
translation.en: I'll keep the fish alive.

items.label: connective particle (〜て form)
items.explanation: Links 生かす to the auxiliary おく to form 〜ておく ('to keep something in a state, done in advance').

items.jp: 夕食を待っているところだ。

translation.pt-BR: Estamos esperando o jantar.
translation.en: We're waiting for dinner.

items.label: connective particle of the 〜て form
items.explanation: て links the verb 待つ to the auxiliary いる, forming the construction 〜ている that expresses a continuous action ('to be waiting').

items.jp: ついでに手紙だしてきてよ。

translation.pt-BR: Já que você vai sair, aproveita e posta a carta, vai.
translation.en: Since you're going out, mail the letter while you're at it.

items.label: links verb to verb (て-form)
items.explanation: Connects 出す to the auxiliary くる to form "post it and come back".

items.jp: ついでに手紙だしてきてよ。

translation.pt-BR: Já que você vai sair, aproveita e posta a carta, vai.
translation.en: Since you're going out, mail the letter while you're at it.

items.label: て-form of the auxiliary / links to the sentence-final particle
items.explanation: Closes the verb construction before the final particle in a casual register.

items.jp: 急に天気が悪くなってきた。

translation.pt-BR: De repente o tempo começou a piorar.
translation.en: All of a sudden the weather started to turn bad.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links なる to the auxiliary くる, forming the pattern 〜てくる, which indicates a gradual change reaching the present.

items.jp: こちらこそ、はじめまして。

translation.pt-BR: O prazer é meu. Muito prazer.
translation.en: Nice to meet you too.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て encerra はじめまし e fecha a fórmula fixa はじめまして; aqui é a forma て cristalizada numa saudação, não uma ligação entre orações.

items.jp: やってることがストーカーみたいになってきた。

translation.pt-BR: O que eu ando fazendo começou a parecer coisa de stalker.
translation.en: What I've been doing has started to look like stalker behavior.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links なる to the auxiliary くる, forming なってくる ('to be coming to become'), which indicates a gradual change.
tokens: term of comparison (base of みたいに)
expression of resemblance (root of みたい)

items.jp: 新しく始めてみようと思う。

translation.pt-BR: Acho que vou tentar começar de novo (do zero).
translation.en: I think I'll try to start over (from scratch).

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links 始め to みる, forming the compound 始めてみる ('to try to start'). It is the particle that joins the main verb to the auxiliary みる in the 〜てみる pattern.
tokens: auxiliary of attempt (〜てみる) in volitional

items.jp: どうしても見えるところに目がいってしまう。

translation.pt-BR: Por mais que eu tente, meus olhos acabam indo para o que está à vista.
translation.en: No matter what I do, my eyes end up drifting to wherever I can see.

items.label: connective particle て
items.explanation: て links いっ to the auxiliary しまう, forming いってしまう ('to end up going').

items.jp: してあげる。

translation.pt-BR: Eu faço isso pra você.
translation.en: I'll do it for you.

items.label: connective particle て (links the verb to the auxiliary)
items.explanation: Here the て turns する into して so it can link to the auxiliary あげる; it is the link that builds the pattern 〜てあげる.

items.jp: この動画を見てほしいんだ。

translation.pt-BR: Quero que você assista a este vídeo.
translation.en: I want you to watch this video.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: this て links 見る to the adjective ほしい, forming the target construction 見てほしい ('to want someone to watch').

items.jp: 鞄をなくしてしまった。

translation.pt-BR: Acabei perdendo minha bolsa.
translation.en: I've lost my bag.

items.label: links verb to auxiliary (te-form)
items.explanation: This て is the -て ending of なくす, needed to attach the auxiliary しまう and form the pattern なくしてしまう.

items.jp: コーヒー、おごってあげるよ。

translation.pt-BR: Eu te pago um café, viu.
translation.en: I'll treat you to a cup of coffee.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links おごる to the auxiliary あげる, forming 〜てあげる ('to do the favor of paying for someone').

items.jp: 運転の仕方は、親が教えてくれたんだ。

translation.pt-BR: Quem me ensinou a dirigir foram meus pais.
translation.en: My parents taught me how to drive.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 教える to the auxiliary くれる, forming the benefactive expression 教えてくれる.
tokens: head of the topic (仕方 = 'way of ~')
copula of the explanatory ending んだ

items.jp: 買い物をしてきてくれる？

translation.pt-BR: Você pode fazer umas compras pra mim?
translation.en: Can you do some shopping for me?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links して to きて, chaining 'do' and 'come/return'.

items.jp: 買い物をしてきてくれる？

translation.pt-BR: Você pode fazer umas compras pra mim?
translation.en: Can you do some shopping for me?

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links きて to くれる, completing the favor structure 〜てくれる.

items.jp: 日毎に寒くなってくる。

translation.pt-BR: Está ficando mais frio dia após dia.
translation.en: It is getting colder day by day.

items.label: connective particle (-te form)
items.explanation: て links なる to the auxiliary くる, forming なってくる ("come to become").

items.jp: 二人は何をしているところですか。

translation.pt-BR: O que vocês dois estão fazendo neste momento?
translation.en: What are you two doing?

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: This て connects する to the auxiliary いる to form している. It is purely structural, with no translation of its own.
tokens: formal noun marking the point of the action (part of the target 〜ているところ)

items.jp: 冬が近づいてくる。

translation.pt-BR: O inverno está chegando.
translation.en: Winter is coming on.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 近づく to くる, forming the structure 〜てくる, which expresses the gradual change toward the present.

items.jp: やってみるよ。

translation.pt-BR: Vou tentar, viu.
translation.en: I'll give it a try.

items.label: connective particle (te-form)
items.explanation: Links やる to the auxiliary みる to form 〜てみる ('to try doing').

items.jp: 私をここから出してほしいの。

translation.pt-BR: Eu quero que você me tire daqui.
translation.en: I want you to get me out of here.

items.label: links the verb to ほしい (てほしい form)
items.explanation: て connects 出して to ほしい, building the pattern 'I want you to do'.
tokens: point of origin of the movement
desiderative adjective of the てほしい pattern

items.jp: 電話を切らずにおいてください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, não desligue o telefone.
translation.en: Please hold the line.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links おく to ください, chaining 'leave it this way' + 'please'.

items.jp: 電話をしてから来てください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, telefone antes de vir.
translation.en: Please phone me before you come.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て puts 来る in the て-form (来て), the base for the request auxiliary ください (〜てください).
tokens: verb of the first action (てから)

items.jp: 電話に出てください。

translation.pt-BR: Atenda o telefone, por favor.
translation.en: Please answer the phone.

items.label: connective particle -て
items.explanation: て turns 出る into 出て (て-form), required to form the request 〜てください.

items.jp: 電車は３０分ごとに走っている。

translation.pt-BR: O trem circula a cada 30 minutos.
translation.en: The train runs every thirty minutes.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 走る to the auxiliary いる, creating the form 走っている that expresses a habit/continuous state.
tokens: suffix (form 〜ごと, part of ごとに)

items.jp: 今日中に答えを出してほしい。

translation.pt-BR: Quero que você me dê a resposta ainda hoje.
translation.en: I need your answer before the end of the day.

items.label: conjunctive (て-form)
items.explanation: て links 出す to ほしい, forming the pattern てほしい of a desire directed at others.
tokens: adverb of time (head of 今日中)
desiderative adjective governing てほしい

items.jp: 鳥が木々の中でさえずっている。

translation.pt-BR: Os pássaros estão cantando entre as árvores.
translation.en: The birds are singing in the trees.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb to the following element (another verb or auxiliary) in the て-form.
tokens: head of the place expression (の中で)

items.jp: 鳥が木の上で歌っている。

translation.pt-BR: Um pássaro está cantando em cima da árvore.
translation.en: A bird is singing in the tree.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 歌う to the auxiliary いる, creating the structure 〜ている which indicates a continuous/ongoing action.
tokens: place modifier (head of the position phrase)

items.jp: 長い事お待たせしてすみません。

translation.pt-BR: Desculpe por tê-lo feito esperar tanto tempo.
translation.en: I am sorry to have kept you waiting so long.

items.label: connective particle 〜て (links the verb to すみません)
items.explanation: Here the 〜て links the action 待たせして ('having made you wait') to the apology expression すみません, forming the pattern 〜てすみません = 'sorry for (having done)...'. It is the central element of the grammatical target.
tokens: main verb of the apology expression

items.jp: 長い間、お待たせしてすみませんでした。

translation.pt-BR: Desculpe por tê-lo feito esperar tanto tempo.
translation.en: I'm sorry I have kept you waiting so long.

items.label: connective particle 〜て (links the verb to すみません)
items.explanation: The 〜て links 待たせして ('having made you wait') to the apology すみませんでした, forming the target pattern 〜てすみません (in the past). It is the piece that structures the apology for an action that already occurred.
tokens: main verb of the apology expression

items.jp: 朝食の用意をしているところです。

translation.pt-BR: Estou bem no meio de preparar o café da manhã.
translation.en: She's getting breakfast ready.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: This て connects する to the auxiliary いる to form している. Structural, with no translation of its own.
tokens: formal noun marking the point of the action (part of the target 〜ているところ)

items.jp: 試していく。

translation.pt-BR: Vou continuar tentando.
translation.en: I'll keep trying.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: this て links 試す to the auxiliary いく, forming the target construction 〜ていく ('to go on doing / to continue doing').

items.jp: 知らせてください。

translation.pt-BR: Por favor, me avise.
translation.en: Please let me know.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links the causative verb to ください, forming the request 'please do'.

items.jp: この服、ちょっとダボっとしていて着づらいな。

translation.pt-BR: Essa roupa está meio folgada e fica difícil de vestir, sabe.
translation.en: These clothes are a bit loose and hard to put on, you know.

items.label: connective particle of the て-form (て)
items.explanation: Forms the 〜ている (している) of continuous state: 'it's loose'.
tokens: mimetic adverb (ダボっと + する = 'to be baggy')
verb of the descriptive state (ダボっとする)
verb stem of the compound 着づらい
adjectival suffix forming 着づらい ('hard to wear')

items.jp: この漢字を字引で引いてみて。

translation.pt-BR: Procura esse kanji no dicionário pra ver.
translation.en: Look up this kanji in the dictionary.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: て links 引く to the auxiliary verb みる, forming 引いてみる ('to look it up and see').

items.jp: 大人しくしているうちはここにいてもよい。

translation.pt-BR: Enquanto você ficar quietinho, pode ficar aqui.
translation.en: You can stay here as long as you keep quiet.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: Links し to いる forming 〜ている (している = to be behaving), expressing a continuous state.

items.jp: 待ってあげる。

translation.pt-BR: Eu te espero.
translation.en: I'll wait for you.

items.label: connective particle (〜て form)
items.explanation: て links the verb 待つ to the auxiliary あげる, forming the construction 〜てあげる; without it the benefactive verb could not be attached.
